Registry outcome denominators are analysis counts for participants with evaluable data, not explicit observed-outcome counts; completion and dropout figures do not establish endpoint ascertainment for each participant.","citations":[{"source_id":"source_edfbc7235f273527b1c583bcaceffb1629946bb7f63513a67029d2376b99afb9","page":1,"start_line":1304,"end_line":1326},{"source_id":"source_edfbc7235f273527b1c583bcaceffb1629946bb7f63513a67029d2376b99afb9","page":1,"start_line":2295,"end_line":2323},{"source_id":"source_206be9da635545b5862fa4653c15765aaef2286af25fa10cee7d8c1f13adc788","page":5,"start_line":22,"end_line":27}],"unknowns":["Week-24 HbA1c observed counts by arm and whether any outcomes were imputed."],"counterevidence":[{"basis_index":0,"implication":"The analysis denominators (132, 134, 133) are relatively close to randomized totals (142, 142, 140), but are not identified as observed-outcome counts."},{"basis_index":1,"implication":"Most participants completed the study, but completion does not itself establish observed HbA1c at the approved time point."}]},{"question_id":"sq:missing:evidence-unbiased","answer":"probably_no","rationale":"No bias-correcting method or sensitivity analysis addressing plausible unobserved week-24 HbA1c values is reported in the supplied material. The primary MMRM analysis and the analysis excluding post-rescue data do not, as described here, establish that any missing-outcome bias was removed.","citations":[{"source_id":"source_206be9da635545b5862fa4653c15765aaef2286af25fa10cee7d8c1f13adc788","page":4,"start_line":44,"end_line":58},{"source_id":"source_206be9da635545b5862fa4653c15765aaef2286af25fa10cee7d8c1f13adc788","page":6,"start_line":14,"end_line":20}],"unknowns":["Whether unsupplied appendix material contains a relevant missing-outcome sensitivity analysis."],"counterevidence":[{"basis_index":0,"implication":"MMRM uses repeated measurements, but the supplied description does not establish that it corrects bias under the relevant missingness mechanism."},{"basis_index":1,"implication":"The no-post-rescue analysis is a different data-handling analysis; no sensitivity to unobserved outcome values is described."}]},{"question_id":"sq:missing:true-value-dependent","answer":"yes","rationale":"It is possible that missing week-24 HbA1c depended on its true value: reported reasons include loss to follow-up, participant withdrawal, adverse events, and death. The supplied report does not link these reasons to HbA1c, so this is a possibility rather than an established relationship.","citations":[{"source_id":"source_edfbc7235f273527b1c583bcaceffb1629946bb7f63513a67029d2376b99afb9","page":1,"start_line":2260,"end_line":2294},{"source_id":"source_206be9da635545b5862fa4653c15765aaef2286af25fa10cee7d8c1f13adc788","page":5,"start_line":22,"end_line":27}],"unknowns":["Whether these participants lacked week-24 HbA1c, and whether their true HbA1c differed from observed participants."],"counterevidence":[{"basis_index":0,"implication":"Reasons for study discontinuation do not prove that outcome data were missing or related to the true outcome."}]},{"question_id":"sq:missing:likely-dependent","answer":"no_information","rationale":"The evidence supports possible dependence but does not establish that dependence was likely. Although loss to follow-up, withdrawal, and adverse events occurred, the supplied material gives no prognostic information or reason-specific relationship to true HbA1c that would support a stronger likelihood judgment.","citations":[{"source_id":"source_edfbc7235f273527b1c583bcaceffb1629946bb7f63513a67029d2376b99afb9","page":1,"start_line":2260,"end_line":2294},{"source_id":"source_206be9da635545b5862fa4653c15765aaef2286af25fa10cee7d8c1f13adc788","page":5,"start_line":22,"end_line":27}],"unknowns":["Whether missing participants' true HbA1c differed systematically from observed participants."],"counterevidence":[{"basis_index":0,"implication":"These documented reasons raise a possible concern but do not establish likely outcome-dependent missingness."}]}],"domain_judgment":"Some concerns due to unresolved outcome availability and no demonstrated bias-correcting analysis; likelihood that missingness depended on true HbA1c is unknown.","scope_limitations":["Raw registry JSON was not recovered; the supplied registry projections and article pages do not provide explicit observed week-24 HbA1c counts or a relevant sensitivity analysis.","This is a source-text diagnostic, not a complete RoB assessment."]}
